moves.label: Quick Ice Blade Check
moves.description: Fast high sword check with a short active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Short standing ice-sword poke hits high and returns to guard.

moves.label: Low Hyorinmaru Sweep
moves.description: Instant low ice sweep with very long active blade pressure.
moves.reason: Low sword/body path sweeps across the leg line.

moves.label: Ice Body Slash
moves.description: Quick mid body slash with a brief active cut and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Forward slash travels through the torso line.

moves.label: Ice Dragon Rush
moves.description: Instant mid ice rush with huge active travel and almost no recovery.
moves.reason: Long ice-cloaked dash sequence fits Toshiro's dragon-like sword pressure.

moves.label: Frost Cross Cut
moves.description: Slow mid cross cut with a long active sword path and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Committed cross-body sword route without special property flags.

moves.label: Hyorinmaru Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid jumping launcher with long active ice pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward ice rush lifts into an authored launcher and leaves the ground.

moves.label: Homing Low Frost Sweep
moves.description: Steady low homing sweep that knocks down after a modest active spin.
moves.reason: Low spinning sword path is authored as homing knockdown.

moves.label: Low Ice Dragon Knockdown
moves.description: Slow low jumping knockdown rush with a long active sword path.
moves.reason: Low-starting ice rush leaves the ground and carries knockdown.

moves.label: Ice Fang Crush
moves.description: Quick mid jumping knockdown crush with a modest active slash.
moves.reason: Airborne mid slash is authored as a knockdown crush.

moves.label: Crouch Ice Rush
moves.description: Fast mid crouch rush with very long active sword pressure.
moves.reason: Full-crouch route advances through repeated ice-sword cuts.

moves.label: Crouch Ice Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with a tiny active lift and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouching sword lift is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Ice Check
moves.description: Steady high overdrive check with a brief active hit and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive route uses the high sword-check animation.

moves.label: Hyorinmaru Aura Drive
moves.description: Instant special knockdown drive with huge active ice-sword pressure.
moves.reason: Long ice aura sequence is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: Rising Ice Slash
moves.description: Quick mid while-rising slash with a brief active cut and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: While-standing command uses the mid ice body-slash family.

moves.label: Rising Ice Rush
moves.description: Fast mid while-rising rush with very long active sword pressure.
moves.reason: Rising route advances through repeated ice rush frames.

moves.label: Ducking Ice Check
moves.description: Steady high ducking check with a brief active hit and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab repeats the high sword-check frames.

moves.label: Diagonal Ice Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid diagonal launcher with a tiny active cut and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward slash carries authored launcher height.

moves.label: Forward Ice Check
moves.description: Slow mid forward check with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward input uses a compact body-height sword check.

moves.label: Forward Ice Slash
moves.description: Quick mid forward slash with a brief active cut and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Forward-heavy command uses the mid body-slash sequence.

moves.label: Hyorinmaru Quick Check
moves.description: Steady high quarter-circle check with a brief active hit and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab repeats the high ice-check frames.

moves.label: Hyorinmaru Burst
moves.description: Fast mid knockdown burst with huge active ice pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Large ice rush burst is authored as a mid knockdown.
